description: The upstream, code-blind NIST-RMF risk-study author (faithful sibling of ebios-sl) that produces each *-rmf-report.md. A soft-side, human-terminus loop: its lower bound is the bin/rmf-lint.sh structural linter PLUS a human terminus (a disjoint realism reviewer + the AO), because content realism has no machine oracle. Dominant coherent-and-wrong: a plausible-but-endogenous report whose scenarios were quietly read off the implementation (collapsing the exogeneity that makes it a valid upper bound for the verification loops), or a structurally-clean report that misses/under-rates a real scenario.

sources.name: NIST RMF / 800-30 / 800-37 / 800-53 corpus
sources.notes: External doctrine transcribed, never read off the code (terrain A). Lives at the REPO ROOT (./nist/*.txt); the cited paths are repo-root-relative — the loop is invoked from repo root, where bin/rmf-lint.sh also lives. The skill is not self-contained under its own dir.

sources.name: Mission, scope, threat model + threat intel
External catalog — MITRE ATT&CK / 800-53 baselines (gold, CONDITIONAL)
sources.notes: Reviewer-only gold authority for an independent completeness enumeration — but its availability is an OPEN question (see SKILL ASSUMPTIONS). If no external catalog is secured, the reviewer falls back to mission+doctrine+STRIDE + its own enumeration, and reviewer exogeneity is ASSERTED, not gold-backed. Listed here as the intended bound; not guaranteed present.

sources.name: bin/rmf-lint.sh structural / coverage / endogeneity linter (C1–C9 gates)
sources.notes: Checks structure/coverage/endogeneity ONLY — explicitly NOT realism.

sources.name: Assessment author's private rationale
sources.notes: A judge (reviewer) must never read it.

sources.name: Independent completeness + realism critique and verdicts
AO acceptance/refusal of residual risk; grant/withhold ATO
The implementation source / codebase under study
sources.notes: The load-bearing barrier: every content actor is barriered from this (author ⊥ code). Reading it collapses the study to endogenous self-certification.

sources.name: The downstream verification scope map (from frama-c-launch)
sources.notes: Enters from the downstream loop; barriered from the author so the study stays exogenous.

sources.name: One design/method claim under test (per probe)
sources.notes: A question posed to the loop, not authored by the probe — keeps the probe non-self-certifying (F4 lesson: probe ids stay distinct from the reviewer's).

sources.name: One recorded probe verdict (linter's actual behaviour)

actors.name: RMF coordinator
actors.builds: Framing (object/goal → RMF step subset), sequencing, Gate-A, gap adjudication, the handoff to frama-c-launch
forbidden_moves: declare done on an author's say-so

actors.name: Assessment author (risk analyst)
actors.builds: R1–R5 from the mission + threat intel + the NIST corpus + STRIDE

upper_bound.text: The mission + threat model + NIST doctrine

lower_bound.text: RMF structural conformance (each clause has a section home)

forbidden_moves: READ THE IMPLEMENTATION SOURCE (the load-bearing exogeneity barrier)

upper_bound.text: NIST doctrine + mission + STRIDE coverage + (gold) an external catalog (MITRE ATT&CK / 800-53 baselines)

lower_bound.text: The coverage linter + its OWN independent enumeration (the enumeration is the reviewer's method; the linter is the immutable oracle that squeezes it)

actors.name: Authorizing Official (risk owner — the human terminus)
actors.builds: Acceptance/refusal of residual risk; grant/withhold the ATO (Authorize)

lower_bound.text: Consults the report + the reviewer's verdicts, then renders a HUMAN acceptance decision — no executable oracle
lower_bound.absent_reason: no executable oracle can settle acceptance/realism — that absence is why the AO is the terminus (the disjoint base)

disjointness.rationale: Every content actor (coordinator, author, reviewer) is barriered from the implementation, so none can read scenarios off the code; the author holds the mission+doctrine (never the reviewer's critique or the scope map), the reviewer holds doctrine+STRIDE+an external gold catalog and its own enumeration (never the author's rationale or the code), and the AO holds the org's risk appetite (never authors the scenarios it accepts). No single pair certifies the report: structure is the linter's, realism is the reviewer's, acceptance is the AO's.
disjointness.load_bearing_barrier: author ⊥ code — the exogeneity invariant. If any content actor read the implementation, the risk study collapses to endogenous self-certification and is no longer a valid upper bound for the verification loops.

catchability.blind_spot: misses / under-rates / code-mirrors a scenario; vacuous coverage
catchability.via: the reviewer's independent enumeration + the rmf-lint endogeneity tripwire
the AO terminus refuses to accept on say-so

catchability.blind_spot: the reviewer itself rubber-stamps or misses a class
catchability.via: the AO weighs residual risk against the org's appetite and can refuse the ATO
org governance / external audit oversight (outside this loop)

catchability.blind_spot: mis-reads the tool's behaviour / over-generalizes one experiment
catchability.via: the coordinator adjudicates probe verdicts at Gate-A; the probe never fixes, only records

disjointness.terminus: Authorizing Official (human risk owner) for acceptance; the disjoint completeness/realism reviewer for realism — no executable oracle settles either.
